n: 700 Series Front Load Washer with Smartboost® - 4.5 Cu. Ft.
desc: The Electrolux 700 Series Front Load Washer (ELFW7738MW) delivers powerful cleaning performance with innovative care technologies. Featuring SmartBoost® Premix Technology, it enhances detergent effectiveness for deep stain removal, even in cold water.
hl: SmartBoost® premixes water and detergent, amplifying its cleaning power for the most effective stain removal, even in cold water to provide better care for clothing.
With features like Cold Wash, Cold Sanitize, and a Care Meter for more sustainable cycle selection, this machine is optimized for better performance in cold.
Optic Whites™ cycle keeps whites whiter
Keep your white clothing and linens looking newer longer with our Optic Whites™ cycle which prevents the redeposit of dirt and other residues, keeping whites whiter than the normal cycle with bleach.
Remove detergent residues and fragrances that can irritate skin with Pure Rinse™ which rinses cleaner than our extra rinse option without using more water.
Quickly clean the items you need most
The magnetic door prop allows washer door to stay ajar to completely dry out seal in between uses, reducing the risk of odor and mildew.
